prompt: In a flat vector illustration style, a vibrant wedding reception unfolds with distinct clarity. On the left side of the frame, a bride in a white gown stands tall, her veil flowing gently behind her. Beside her, a groom in a black tuxedo smiles broadly, his hands clasped tightly together. A photographer in a blue vest crouches nearby, holding a large silver camera up to his eye. Next to the photographer, a small brown dog sits patiently on the polished floor, wearing a tiny red bow tie. In the center, a long wooden table stretches across the scene, covered with a crisp white cloth. Atop the table rests a three-tiered white cake adorned with pink flowers. A waiter in a green apron stands behind the table, carefully handing a glass of champagne to a guest in a yellow dress. The guest in the yellow dress reaches out eagerly, her eyes fixed on the bubbling liquid. Seated at the table is an elderly woman in a purple shawl, who is looking at a young boy in a striped shirt next to her. The young boy points excitedly at a floating red balloon tied to his chair. To the right, a band performs on a small stage. A drummer in a leather jacket hits the cymbals with enthusiasm. Beside him, a singer in a sparkly gold dress holds a microphone close to her mouth. An audience member in a gray suit claps his hands rhythmically while standing near the stage. Another guest in a floral print dress dances joyfully, her arms raised high in the air. A child in a blue romper crawls on the floor, chasing a scattered confetti piece. A grandmother in a beige coat watches the child with a warm smile, holding a pearl necklace. A man in a red scarf leans against a pillar, observing the festivities with crossed arms. There is no smoke in the air. There is no rain visible through any windows. There is no clutter or debris on the floor.
